bentkowska.family: Daughter of Danuta and lawyer/politician Aleksander Bentkowski
bentkowska.education: Law, UMCS Rzeszów branch (1991, administrative law thesis); scholarship DePaul University Chicago; PhD theory of law UMCS Lublin 2014 (Andrzej Korybski)
bentkowska.career_notes: Specialist in criminal, family, labour, and personal-rights protection law

szostek.education: Law, University of Silesia 1997; PhD 2003 (electronic legal acts); habilitation University of Wrocław
szostek.career_notes: Professor University of Silesia; specialist in civil law, new technologies, AI, cybersecurity, blockchain. Expert European Parliament AI Observatory. Founder/director of Śląskie Centrum Inżynierii Prawa, Technologii i Kompetencji Cyfrowych 'CYBER SCIENCE' (consortium with UŚ, UE Katowice, Politechnika Śląska, NASK). Horizon 2020 grants: SHOP4CF, MAS4AI. Co-author of e-sąd concept and electronic delivery confirmation. Legal adviser.

patyra.education: Law, UMCS Lublin 1994; PhD 2000 (status of Prime Minister under 1997 Constitution); habilitation 2012
patyra.career_notes: Professor UMCS (head of Constitutional Law Department) and University of Radom. Member of Polish Society of Constitutional Law board. 2024: supervisory board PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna. Previously recommended by opposition as candidate for Ombudsman. Legal adviser (OIRP Lublin). Author of numerous constitutional-law opinions for Sejm, Senate, KRRiP, MoJ, MoF.
